@graph.headline: Help Scout vs Zendesk: Pricing and Features

mainEntity.name: Is Help Scout cheaper than Zendesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout has a free plan and Standard is listed at $25 per user/month. Zendesk Support Team is $19 per agent/month paid yearly, while Suite Team is $55. Compare the features you need, not only the starting price.

mainEntity.name: Is Zendesk better for large support teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zendesk is the stronger shortlist option when a team needs advanced routing, multiple channels, formal ticket workflows, and detailed service operations.

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout include a knowledge base?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Help Scout Docs is included in every plan, with site and article limits that vary by tier. Zendesk includes a knowledge base in Suite Team and higher plans.

mainEntity.name: Can I migrate Zendesk tickets to Help Scout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout lists Zendesk as a supported import source. The standard import can move tickets or conversations with customer profiles and tags, but not users, inbox settings, help articles, macros, automations, custom fields, ticket types, or custom statuses.

mainEntity.name: Which is better for a small email support team?

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout is often the simpler fit when email and self-service content are the main needs. Zendesk may be better when the team already needs formal ticket routing or more channels.
